body.p: Stupid guy. Two guys lived, two hunters, two brothers. One day they went hunting in distant forest, they hunted and got squirrels. They hunted and got a lot of squirrels. The sun has not bent down to the earth yet. It hadn't set yet. It was still standing. The older brother says to the younger one: "It will soon be dark. Recently I saw a trail. I saw a sable's trail. I'll see where it ran to. And you - there is a river there - in the bend of this river set up a tent, tie up the reindeer, make tea". The youngest replied: "All right, I'll set up the tent, make tea while you're gone. I'm off. And you go to the taiga, go and look for sable tracks". He said and went to the bend of the river, which was in front of him. The younger brother went to the river. The elder brother followed the tracks of that sable for some time. He pursued it, pursued it, trampled all over the forest. Then it got dark, it was night. "I'll check on my brother, how he put up the tent. He's probably making tea." So he went back. He followed the footsteps of his comrade. He came down to the bend of the river. He reached the river. His brother is sitting on the bank of the river. He's sitting on the bank, crying. He is crying there, his clothes are all wet. The older man then asks: "Why are you crying? Why are your clothes all wet?" The younger guy replies: "You see," he says, "you told me: "You'll put a tent for us in the river, light a fire for us. You will make a tent for us." I spent a long time putting up the tent. The tent did not want to stand. The current carried it away. I got all my clothes wet. I didn't put up the tent, I was tired". Then the older brother said: "You're so clever! Where is your mind? Didn't I tell you: "In the bend of the river," I said, "to put it on the riverbed?" By the river, in the forest by the river. Why didn't you listen to the elder? Why didn't you listen? Listen when the elders speak," he used to say, "when the elder speaks, listen well. Whatever he is talking about." That was the end of the story.
